explanations: Correct. 10 > 5 is true, the if block is executed.
10 > 5 is true, the else block is not executed.
The if is executed because the condition is true.

questions.question: Which operator do you use to compare whether two primitive values are equal?
explanations: Correct. == compares whether two primitive values are equal.
equals() is for comparing String objects.

questions.question: What happens if an if has no block (no braces)?
options: Nothing, the if executes no code
explanations: An empty if compiles, it just does nothing.
Correct. An if without a block executes no code and continues.
The else only runs if it exists and the condition is false.
It does not throw an exception.
